cells.gaps: No share of local offices is published: 87 Traditional Authority service points in five of 28 districts stand against 277 TAs and 138 Sub-TAs listed for expansion, and the 58 health facilities (2025), 142 health centres (plan) and 180 health facilities said to be digitalised (MWI-002, 2026, no total, not said to register births there) carry no total. MWI-001 records 100 printers handed over for TA-level offices on 9 October 2026, a delivery and not offices entering records. MWI-039 (owner:partner, CDC and EGPAF maintaining the CRVS system) disagrees with the newer owner:ministry rows; MWI-033 records CDC funding expected to stop in March 2026, an expectation and not an event; the NRB's own 2025 pages (MWI-049, MWI-052) describe a paper NR8 procedure and name no digital system; the rural gap rests on MWI-044 (2024), which gives no figure. MWI-007 to MWI-011 are from an excluded source: none was used.
cells.note: Births and deaths are entered on Nzika kits at Traditional Authority offices and on CRVS kits that synchronise with the central NRIS, past the pilot since late 2025. Stage 4 needs more than half of local offices on a share or a count with a denominator, and 87 service points in five districts is a minority.
